comment: Anchor table for the ji→ns cutover plan. Paths are PRE-MV (as in the current tree); synthesis rewrites .ji/→.ns/, .pi/extensions/ji.ts→ns.ts, skills/ji-flow-*→skills/ns-flow-* to post-mv form. NO ji.toml mv this window (phase-two surface). Changeset membership is FIXED here — classifiers never assign changesets. Every file:line below was verified against the live tree 2026-07-03.

cs1-workspace-globs.why: Hard build breaker: the three configs must carry the byte-identical ../.ns/reviews/*/tools/* glob or pnpm install/tsgo fail. Lockfile excluded (regenerates).
cs1-workspace-globs.notes: ts/pnpm-workspace.yaml:4, ts/package.json:53 (workspaces array), ts/tsconfig.json:34-35 (two include lines) all carry `../.ji/reviews/*/tools/*` forms → `../.ns/reviews/*/tools/*`. Nothing else in these files renames this window: the package.json "ji": { manifest key (if present here) and any @ji/* references are phase-two survivors.

cs2-shell-cd-directive.why: THE named trap: the shell wrapper derives its cd-directive env var from commandName (`${commandName.toUpperCase()}_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE` in capability-kit/src/kit/shell-support.ts:44 — parameterized, NOT in this changeset, no literal to edit) while the slot-side reader HARDCODES the var name. Wrapper says NS_, reader says JI_ ⇒ silent cd-directive split-brain (slot checkout stops moving the parent shell, no crash). One agent owns every hardcoded side plus both zshrc sentinel duplicates and all asserting tests.
cs2-shell-cd-directive.notes: kernel/src/cli/shell.ts: sentinel markers :17-18 "# >>> ji shell integration >>>"/"# <<< ji shell integration <<<" → ns forms (the marker-holding identifiers sdlShellIntegrationBeginMarker/End are STALE sdl-era identifiers — leave the identifiers, rename only the string values), install prose :46,52,85-88, commandName: "ji" → "ns" :92. completion.ts:22 commandName: "ji" → "ns". slot/src/ji/extension.ts re-hardcodes the SAME markers :107-108 (must stay byte-equal with kernel's), wrapper commandName :159, install prose :183-228. cd-directive.ts:6 SLOT_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE stays; :7 `export const SDL_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE = "JI_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE"` → `export const NS_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE = "NS_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE"` — owner-decided exception to the identifier-survivor rule: this identifier is two renames stale, rename it too, and update BOTH importers in this changeset: slot/src/core/index.ts:10 (re-export) and the test imports in api.test.ts:9,102,128 and cd-directive.test.ts:5,68 (fixture value /tmp/ji-directive → /tmp/ns-directive :68-72). Tests: shell-cli.test.ts:25,48 and slot-alias-cli.test.ts:39 assert the wrapper text contains JI_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE → NS_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE (plus any `ji()` wrapper-name and marker assertions in those files). Do NOT touch SLOT_CD_DIRECTIVE_FILE anywhere, and do NOT rename identifiers other than the one cd-directive exception.

Coupling ruling 2026-07-03 (from classification round): render-cli-shim.mjs REQUIRED_ENV_VARS (JI_TEMPLATE/JI_OUTPUT/JI_TOOL/JI_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT/JI_CLI_REL_PATH/JI_INSTALL_HINT/JI_FALLBACK_MODE) and the two areg source-cli-shim tests assert the same JI_* names the justfile sets - all renamed together in this changeset.

mvOnly.comment: Caller-owned git mv targets. Tree/dir moves are bracketed by the orchestrator; engine agents NEVER rename files. .pi/extensions/ji.ts content is all phase-two survivors (an @ji/flow import + the ./pi/sdl-extension subpath + a stale sdlExtension identifier) — mv only, no content edit. The four skill DIRS move in the bracket but their SKILL.md contents ARE edited (skills cohort / simple anchors, post-mv paths); they are listed here for the bracket inventory, and prepass filters them out of file-level subtraction.
